body:
From the #569 follow-up (`fix/569-plot-registration`, plot_labor/plot_inputs registration).

**NaN keys** (Feature frame, 2026-10-19):

| table | level | country counts |
|---|---|---|
| `plot_labor` | `plot_id` | Uganda 3,656, Malawi 40 |
| `plot_labor` | `v` | Ethiopia 1,823, Uganda 1,235, Nigeria 108, GhanaLSS 1 |
| `plot_inputs` | `v` | Ethiopia 882, Uganda 729, Nigeria 63, GhanaLSS 2 |
| `plot_inputs` | `plot_id` | Uganda 1 |

- The `v` NaNs come from the sample join: households missing from `sample()`.
- Feature serves these rows intact. They are deferred deletions.

**Strict-mode flip** (r1-measured). Under `LSMS_READ_STRICT=1`, these reads now raise `NullIndexKeyError` on `v`; on base they did not:
- `Country('Ethiopia').plot_labor()`
- `Country('Nigeria').plot_labor()`
- `Country('Ethiopia').plot_inputs()`

The same thing happened to crop_production at its registration. This gates any CI `LSMS_READ_STRICT=1`.

**Tier:** B (per-country households missing from `sample()`).
title: #569 residual C: NaN keys on declared plot-table index levels, now all named by Site I; `LSMS_READ_STRICT=1` newly raises on three reads
